LANE 7 ARM_1: the N-sweep. Does per-token collection with another channel
outstanding still overlap?

THE QUESTION, REFRAMED (coordinator, verbatim): arm B was already N=2 / lag=1
with a JOINT collect, so the test is per-token collection with the other channel
outstanding.

That is narrower than "does lag rescue it". Arm B evaluated both streams with a
single mx.eval(o1, o2) -- submit-both-then-collect-both, which IS lag=1 with N=2,
i.e. already the shippable configuration. What it did not do is collect PER
TOKEN. This arm does, via MultiStreamDriver: submit all channels, then collect
them one at a time, so while channel 0 is being drained channel 1's forward is
still outstanding.

lag IS PINNED AT 1 for every real channel. An autoregressive channel cannot run
ahead -- step N+1 needs step N's token, which does not exist until step N is
collected, and submitting ahead silently reuses a stale input (measured:
[0,0,1,1] where correct is [0,1,2]). The driver refuses it. So the sweep is over
CHANNELS, not lookahead.

  primary   N = 1, 2, 3 at lag=1  -- the real serving configurations
  secondary lag = 2, 4 on ONE non-sequential fixed-shape probe, LABELLED as a
            characterisation only: any gain there is reachable in production by
            adding channels, never by lookahead on a decode channel.

DECISION RULE (pre-registered): REAL if aggregate >= 1.10x vs the sum of solo
rates AND every channel keeps >= 95% of its solo per-token rate, at N>=2.
DEAD otherwise -> the multi-stream design brief downgrades to "batching only"
and 1.257x is recorded as a joint-collect artefact.
SPLIT (report, do not hide): aggregate clears but one channel keeps <95% ->
overlap is real but UNFAIR; name which channel loses and by how much.

2.note: NON-SEQUENTIAL fixed-shape probe. Characterisation only -- not a serving configuration.

4.note: NON-SEQUENTIAL fixed-shape probe. Characterisation only -- not a serving configuration.

VERDICT: DEAD - best aggregate 1.016x < 1.10x. The 1.257x was a joint-collect artefact; the design brief downgrades to batching only.
